children: Van den Bergh, who took over as CEO in 2018, purchased the shares on Thursday at an average price of 98p each, for a total value of £24,500.
Following the purchase, Van den Bergh holds a beneficial interest in 644,934 ordinary Trufin shares, representing approximately 1.2% of the company's issued share capital.
As of 1535 BST, Trufin shares were up 0.20% at 98.70p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
